answer: Each identity registers a genesis key in the nadir registry for 60 credits. Each epoch it posts a rotation proof, a new key signed by the old key, chained to the genesis key on the horizon ledger. Auditors verify chains, deep-auditing under the pulse threshold; a gap, reused key, or fork burns the bond. Witnesses cap eight signatures per epoch, so fake k pays 25 plus 10 per earlier block of eight; fake 1000 pays 1265; 1000 fakes lock 60000 and pay 645000. A rented-chain ring fails: rented rotations carry wrong predecessor signatures and burn. Honest agents rotate once, keep the bond, pay 25.
